en.headline: Jury discharged in Abby Choi murder trial after juror withdraws
en.dek: Deputy Judge Brian Keith ordered a fresh panel to be selected on Wednesday after one of nine jurors cited health concerns.
body: The High Court on Monday discharged the nine-member jury in the murder trial of three men accused of killing socialite Abby Choi Tin-fung after one juror applied to withdraw for health reasons.

Deputy Judge Brian Keith said the juror had written citing concerns that stress from the trial could aggravate a medical condition. The judge ruled that the remaining eight could not continue because the prosecution had not yet opened its case, and a direct replacement is not permitted by law.

A new jury will be empanelled on Wednesday. The three defendants—Choi’s former husband Kwong Kong-chi, former brother-in-law Kwong Kong-kit and former father-in-law Kwong Kau—face charges of murder and preventing the lawful burial of a corpse stemming from events in February 2023.

zh.headline: 蔡天鳳謀殺案陪審員因健康退出 法官解散陪審團周三重選
zh.dek: 高等法院副法官祈彥輝接納一名陪審員健康理由申請，原定今日開案陳詞押後，周三重新抽選陪審團。
body: 高等法院今日解散蔡天鳳謀殺案的九人陪審團，因一名陪審員以健康理由申請退出。
副法官祈彥輝表示，該陪審員上周去信指擔心審訊壓力加重病情。法官認為審訊尚未進入控方開案陳詞及舉證階段，不宜由餘下八人繼續，而法例亦不允許直接替補。
法庭將於周三重新抽選陪審團。三名被告為死者前丈夫鄺港智、前大伯鄺港傑及前家翁鄺球，各被控謀殺及阻止合法埋葬屍體罪，案件涉2023年2月大埔龍尾村事件。
